novelty_proof: The synchronized residual Martingale cycle mechanism did NOT exist in the codebase before Round 18. R1-R17 only ran INDEPENDENT per-symbol cycles (MartingaleCycleState holds ONE symbol's legs). Round 18 introduces SynchronizedCycleState: a single aggregate cycle whose legs (5+ symbols) open FO at the same timestamp, add SO in lockstep on aggregate cycle net loss + adverse residual, and TP/close together.

r2_1_config.in_effective_config_hash: true — field on MartingaleRiskLimits.synchronized_cycle, serializes into the config JSON the Python orchestrator hashes

r2_2_engine.entry: pub fn run_synchronized_cycle_replay(cfg, fits, bars, funding, budget) -> Result<MartingaleBacktestResult, String>

machine_definition_implemented.cycle_open: residual_z from train-frozen (beta,mu,sigma); |z|>=entry_z -> all legs FO at same timestamp, dollar-beta neutral
machine_definition_implemented.safety_order: aggregate net PnL<0 AND residual moved adversely by so_residual_step_z since last fill -> all surviving legs add notional at multiplier scale; group aggregate notional strictly increases; capped by group_gross_cap_pct
machine_definition_implemented.take_profit: aggregate net PnL(after fee/funding/slippage) > tp_net_bps_floor AND |z|<=exit_z -> all legs reduce/close together
machine_definition_implemented.abort: cycle_deadline_h OR end-of-window force-close -> only real aggregate reduce/close; loss enters equity

r2_2_engine.anti_cheat: validate_martingale_contract() rejects multiplier<=1.0 or max_legs<2 (not_martingale). A config that never produces a real SO is recorded groups_with_so=0 and flagged.
r2_2_engine.anti_overfit: All (beta,mu,sigma,half_life) come from train-only SynchronizedFit passed by the caller; engine never re-fits.
r2_2_engine.funding_per_leg: applied per funding event to each active cycle's matching leg (formula -sign*notional*rate)

r2_3_selftest.method: OLS cointegration fit of BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT on F1 train (2023-01-01..2023-06-30): log(ETH)=beta*log(BTC)+mu. beta=1.2931 mu=0.5048 sigma=0.03702 half_life=142h. Run 5 param variants over a 90-day F1 validation slice at 4999U budget.
r2_3_selftest.interpretation: Every config opens a synchronized cycle (FO=2 legs), and every config produces at least one synchronized SO (groups_with_so=1). This is the FIRST genuine loss-after-add Martingale cycle in the project's 17 rounds. No principal breach at the <5000U budget.

conclusion: R2 NATIVE SYNCHRONIZED CYCLE DOMAIN PASSED. The M1 pair mechanism exists, is faithful to plan §2 machine definition, runs on real data, produces genuine FO+SO evidence, and survives at small capital. R3 wires this into a binary (done) and adds production parity skeleton.
